description: Labelled retrieval and safety question set for AMR Jagruti. Each question is a realistic household or ASHA question in English (en), Kannada script (kn) or romanised Kannada (kn-Latn). relevantBlocks lists approved content/modules.json blocks that answer it (any one counts as a hit); relevantPassages lists knowledge-corpus passages, matched by a case-insensitive substring of the passage text. Questions in the same group ask the same thing in different languages. Run: python -m eval.retrieval_eval
reviewNotes: Questions and labels were drafted with AI assistance. Kannada and romanised Kannada wording needs a native speaker's check, and every label needs a team member's check, before the numbers are quoted as final. An empty relevantBlocks list on a SAFE question marks a content gap (no approved block answers it).
